steps.note: S1.3.1.1.1 states the subtract/add/restore rows and that the net target change is (JV+RG)x whatever the scratch values a,c, quoting line 748.
S1.3.1.1.2 gives the bit-case central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2, side injection cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, and self coefficient 1.
S1.3.1.1.2 gives the complex-case central coefficient (|S∩T|-1)/2 with side injection cancelling intersections zero and two.
S1.3.1.1.3 states the inverse schedule X←X−Y and the stages (x,y)→(x,y+x)→(−y,y+x)→(−y,x), each invocation restoring its scratch wires.
The plan asserts nested labels on every edge and says other edges 'split along A=B⊥P and F=⟨t⟩⊥t^⊥' (S1.3.1.3.5), but never gives the per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions.
S1.3.1.3.4 states ⟨t_X⟩⊂t_Y^⊥ for neighbours and the residual P⊗⟨t_X,t_Y⟩^⊥ of dimension h−2.
The plan states the only decreasing edge is center 3→4 losing h, telescoping to sinks Wm−N minus sources N giving Wm−2N, and the absolute total Wm−2N+2L with L=Ich.
S1.3.3.3 only asserts that every nonzero binary residual has an orthonormal basis; the nondegenerate-and-nonalternating argument and the absorption of alternating planes are not stated.
S1.3.1.6 gives L/N = 100/539 for the bit network and 101/539 for the complex network.
S1.3.3.1 states the weight identity, additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, and q_V−q_U=Σ_v wt(v)[v·x] over an orthonormal residual basis, negated on decreasing edges.
S1.3.3.2 states wt(v) odd, the phase i^{ε[v·x]} decomposition, and H diag(1,−1) H = X giving aI+bX_v or its inverse.
The plan counts s_c kernels and says roles receive C^{⊗m} 'on any number of columns', but never states that on k columns the frame change factors as one tensored factor K^{⊗k} per residual vector.
S1.3.3.4–S1.3.3.5 give frames I and C^{⊗m}, C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a) for X_a→Y_a, repair by Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} via C=iZC^{-1}Z, and negation of the X outputs.
S1.3.1.6 says both ratios are below 1/2 and S1.3.2.3 gives the deficit N−2L_b>0 so s_b<W_b m.
S1.3.4 states both deficits exceed 20·2^{-50}, log m<20 gives m^{1−2^{-50}}>m(1−η), hence s/W<m^τ with τ=σ=1−2^{-50}.

S1.4.1.1 states the factorization A=E_1ΠE_2 with lower-triangular invertible factors obtained by repeatedly eliminating around the rightmost nonzero entry of the topmost nonzero row, Π having exactly a ones; the lower-triangular clearing is stated only through the factors' form.
S1.4.1 fixes an odd prime q avoiding the denominators of the factorization so the shear is performed over Z/q^b with invertible lower-triangular factors.
S1.4.1.2 states a lower-triangular change costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order, earlier coordinates still holding original values.
S1.4.1.3 gives D_j←D_j+H_i, an interchange, D_j←H_i−D_j, yielding (h+d,d) with one interchange, a in all.
Only Δ=⌈C_0 d^{C_1}⌉ appears (S1.5.9); E, B, ν, C_1=max{20,ν+3}, C_0=128mB^2 and the values ν=11, C_1=20 are not stated.
The plan never states the depth recurrence A(e)≤sA(e/m)+E, the leaf bound 8e, or the per-invocation count below E.
S1.5.9 asserts depth at most C_0 d^{C_1} without the unrolling B^{k+1}≤B^2 d^ν or the bound 8B^2 d^{ν+1}.

S1.5.9 states the p+Δ / Δ+3 bit reservation and Δ=o(p) from εC_1<1, but omits the defining link that depth ℓ gives values in 2^{-(p+ℓ)}Z[i] of modulus at most 2^ℓ, so the step is asserted rather than carried out.
S1.5.10 states each row has absolute row sum one, so disks are preserved and the final truncation errs by less than √2·2^{-p}.

summary: P01 carries the bank-exchange network, rank-saving and matrix-shear sub-steps in full and most of the label budget and phase interface, but omits the residual table (L1), the binary orthonormal-basis argument (L4), the k-column tensoring (P3), and the whole precision derivation of the simultaneous layer except the final row-sum bound (S1–S4): 19 of 26 present, none wrong.
